_note: Polite follow-up templates for hunter-followup. Placeholders in {braces} are filled from hunter/pipeline.json and hunter/profile.json; anything left as [fill: ...] must be written by you (one specific, true line). Every draft is shown to you first and goes out only after your yes.

nudge-1.use: First follow-up on an outreach thread with no reply, 3 days after the first message (the reel: Day 1 email, Day 4 follow-up). Short, adds one new specific thing, easy to ignore.
nudge-1.subject: Re: {subject}

nudge-2.use: Second and LAST follow-up, about a week after the first one. Says it is the last note. After this, nothing more is sent.
nudge-2.subject: Re: {subject}

application-check-in.use: A check-in on an application with no news, at least 10 days after applying, to a contact you already have at that company. One message, not a series.
application-check-in.subject: {role} application, {my_name}

thank-you.use: Thank-you note within 24 hours of an interview or screen. One specific moment from the conversation, one line on fit, no new asks.
thank-you.subject: Thank you, {role} interview

after-coffee.use: Thank-you after a coffee chat with a hiring manager or a warm intro. Thanks them, names one thing you will act on, and only then mentions the application.
after-coffee.subject: Thank you for the coffee chat
after-coffee.body:
Hi {first},

Thank you for making time for coffee. Your point about [fill: one thing they said] was really useful, and I am going to [fill: what you will do with it].

I have just applied for the {role} role on your team. If it is ever helpful, I am glad to share more about [fill: the project you talked about].

Thanks again,
{my_first}

confirm-time.use: Reply when they offer a time. Confirms it, says who sends the invite, nothing else. The calendar invite goes out only with your approval.
confirm-time.subject: Re: {subject}
confirm-time.body:
Hi {first},

{day} works great, thank you. I will send a calendar invite with a video link so it is easy to find.

Looking forward to it,
{my_first}
